assessment.summary: Two systemic hardening opportunities developed: centralized archive pre-flight validation and session-scoped workspace isolation.

assumptions: Single-node or workstation deployment target with optional shared web access.

opportunities.title: Unified Session-Scoped Workspace and Path Isolation Boundary
opportunities.summary: Isolate user workspaces, progress state, and generated media across multi-tenant web sessions and API tasks.
opportunities.diagnosis: FastAPI and Gradio previously operated on global title-based paths in audiobook_output without tenant ownership.

evidence.claim: FastAPI worker allowed arbitrary output_dir paths escaping workspace.
Gradio UI permitted cross-session overwrite of progress state by matching book title.
Cached chapter text was disclosed across sessions on title collision.

desiredInvariants: Every progress read/write evaluates session ownership against the caller.
Output directories resolve strictly within ABM_OUTPUT_BASE.

options.title: In-Memory Ownership Registry & Strict Subpath Anchoring
options.summary: Enforce session ownership in Gradio handlers and canonicalize API output paths to ABM_OUTPUT_BASE.

evidenceCoverage.rationale: Directly anchors API worker output_dir within ABM_OUTPUT_BASE.
Registers progress owners per session and blocks unauthorized overwrites.
Prevents unauthorized loading of cached chapter text across sessions.

tradeoffs.assessment: Neutralizes path traversal and title-collision data disclosure.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Run automated session ownership and output dir tests.

tradeoffs.assessment: O(1) memory lookup for session tokens adds no latency.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Verify response latency on UI events.

tradeoffs.assessment: Negligible memory overhead for ownership dictionary.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Inspect heap size under concurrent session simulation.

tradeoffs.assessment: Eliminates accidental race conditions where users overwrite each other's progress.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Simulate simultaneous generation tasks with matching titles.

tradeoffs.assessment: No external infrastructure or database dependencies introduced.
Fully backwards compatible with existing local setups.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Verify existing progress files continue to load.

residualRisks: In-memory registry resets on process restart.

workPackages: Anchor API worker output_dir to ABM_OUTPUT_BASE.
acceptanceCriteria: Path traversal payload in API returns sanitized bounded path.
implementationReadiness.rollback: Revert session checks and path anchoring commits.

opportunities.recommendation: Adopt Option 1 immediately as verified by automated test suite.

opportunities.title: Centralized Archive Pre-flight Ingestion & Resource Sandboxing
opportunities.summary: Introduce strict uncompressed size, member count, and structural geometry limits before archive extraction.
opportunities.diagnosis: Parsers decompressed untrusted zip entries (EPUB/DOCX/ODT) and expanded huge table/page ranges into memory without limits.

evidence.claim: Docling engine uncompressed nested EPUB zip bombs to gigabytes in memory.
PDF page range expansion allowed unbounded page iteration causing DoS.
HTML table colspan/rowspan attributes in EPUB caused 100k x 100k matrix allocations.

desiredInvariants: No archive file exceeding 512 MiB uncompressed size or 2000 entries is decompressed.
PDF page range extractions are bounded to max 5000 pages and 20M characters.
HTML table spans are clamped to max 1000 cells.

options.title: Unified Pre-Flight Archive & Structural Quotas
options.summary: Pre-flight validation using _assert_zip_safe and geometry clamping before passing to parsers.

evidenceCoverage.rationale: Enforces 512 MiB and 2000 member limits on EPUB archives.
Caps PDF page extraction to 5,000 pages and 20M characters.
Clamps colspan and rowspan to 1000 in HTML preprocessing.

tradeoffs.assessment: Neutralizes zip bomb expansion and parser algorithmic complexity attacks.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Run bomb fixtures and verify clean rejection.

tradeoffs.assessment: Zip header inspection takes less than 5ms.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Benchmark extraction time on standard documents.

tradeoffs.assessment: Guarantees process memory cannot be exhausted by crafted archives.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Measure memory footprint during malicious file ingestion.
Test continuous server operation under adversarial inputs.

tradeoffs.assessment: Pure Python implementation with no OS-specific configuration.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Test on Linux, macOS, and Windows.

tradeoffs.assessment: Legitimate books easily fit well within the 512 MiB / 5,000 page quota.

residualRisks: Extremely large encyclopedic documents (>512 MiB uncompressed text) require configuration override.

workPackages: Add regex table span clamping in _preprocess_html.
acceptanceCriteria: Zip bomb archives raise ValueError and return empty/fail cleanly.
Unbounded PDF page ranges are clamped.

opportunities.recommendation: Adopt Option 1 immediately as verified by automated test suite.
